items.title: Jane Monheit interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 20, 2010
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... I’m very pleased to have Jane Monheit as my guest

ctx.x: Jane was interviewed in Clinton, NY, on August 20, 2010, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe, off camera, and we are at Hamilton College. I’m very pleased to have Jane Monheit as my guest for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
